pages.quiz:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which noun goes with "mein"? (1 mark)
   A. Schwester
   B. Tante
   C. Vater
   D. Mutter

2. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom"? (1 mark)
   A. Das Bett ist in der Schlafzimmer.
   B. Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer.
   C. Das Bett ist im Garten.
   D. Der Tisch ist im Schlafzimmer.

3. Which day means "the middle of the week"? (1 mark)
   A. Mittwoch
   B. Montag
   C. Freitag
   D. Sonntag

4. Which day comes right after Samstag? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Mittwoch
   C. Sonntag
   D. Montag

5. What number is "fünf"? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 12
   C. 5
   D. 15

6. What does "das Knie" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. knee
   B. ear
   C. finger
   D. neck

7. What does "das Gewitter" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. rain
   B. thunderstorm
   C. rainbow
   D. sky

8. How is the letter Q named in German? (1 mark)
   A. emm
   B. ee
   C. fow
   D. koo

9. How is "sch" pronounced in "Schule"? (1 mark)
   A. like ts
   B. like sh
   C. like s
   D. like k

10. What does "nett" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. kind
   B. old
   C. small
   D. tall or big

11. Which little word goes with the noun "Tochter"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. der
   D. die

12. What does "das Bett" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sofa
   B. bed
   C. bathroom
   D. door

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Kühlschrank"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. das
   C. den
   D. der

14. What does "die Party" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. song
   B. party
   C. birthday
   D. cake

15. What does "der Kuchen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cake
   B. candle
   C. present
   D. party

16. What does "der Kakao" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mango
   B. watermelon
   C. cheese
   D. cocoa

17. Which little word goes with the noun "Brot"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. das
   C. die
   D. der

18. Which food group does "der Kohl" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Gemüse
   C. das Fleisch
   D. das Obst

19. What does "der Fuß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eye
   B. foot
   C. arm
   D. shoulder

20. What does "schwarze Haare" mean? (1 mark)
   A. brown eyes
   B. small feet
   C. big hands
   D. black hair

21. What does "Womit sehe ich?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. Who is that?
   B. Where do I sleep?
   C. What do I see with?
   D. What do I hear with?

22. What does "helfen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to help
   B. to sleep
   C. to learn or study
   D. to drink

23. Which verb form completes "Vater ___ ein Buch"? (lesen) (1 mark)
   A. lese
   B. liest
   C. lest
   D. lesen

24. Which little word goes with the noun "Mutter"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. das
   D. der

25. Which little word goes with the noun "Tisch"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

26. Which German word or phrase means "lamp"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kühlschrank
   B. die Lampe
   C. das Zimmer
   D. die Gabel

27. Which room name contains the letter ü? (1 mark)
   A. Zimmer
   B. Küche
   C. Garten
   D. Flur

28. Which German word means "to dance"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. kochen
   B. duschen
   C. lesen
   D. tanzen

29. Which German word means "to read"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. tanzen
   B. trinken
   C. lesen
   D. hören

30. Which German word means "November"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. März
   C. Mai
   D. September

31. Which German word means "September"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. August
   B. Juni
   C. September
   D. November

32. What does "der erste" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sixth
   B. third
   C. first
   D. seventh

33. Which German word or phrase means "juice"? (1 mark)
   A. der Kohl
   B. der Saft
   C. der Reis
   D. das Mittagessen

34. Which little word goes with the noun "Banane"? (1 mark)
   A. der
   B. die
   C. den
   D. das

35. Which German word or phrase means "bean"? (1 mark)
   A. die Bohne
   B. die Wassermelone
   C. die Mango
   D. die Zwiebel

36. Which German word or phrase means "mouth"? (1 mark)
   A. das Haar
   B. der Zeh
   C. der Mund
   D. der Bauch

37. Which word has a silent h that makes the vowel long? (1 mark)
   A. Mund
   B. Bauch
   C. Zahn
   D. Kopf

38. What does "heiß" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. dry
   B. cold
   C. hot
   D. windy

39. What does "kühl" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloudy
   B. warm
   C. windy
   D. cool

40. Which completes "Das Bild hängt an ___ Wand"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. dem
   D. den

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Write three sentences in German that say where things are in your room. (3 marks)

42. Write the German greetings for "good morning" and "good evening". (2 marks)

43. Give two safety rules for sending messages online. (2 marks)

44. Write three healthy foods and two unhealthy foods in German. (3 marks)

45. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear, cloud, cake. (5 marks)

46. A child arrives at school in the morning. Write in German what the child says to the teacher, and how the teacher asks how the child is, and the child's answer. (4 marks)

47. Write the German words with der, die or das for: knife, balloon. (2 marks)

48. Write the German words with their articles for: kitchen, bedroom, garden, living room. (4 marks)

49. Explain why you should use reliable sources when you research a famous person's birthday. (2 marks)

50. Explain how the adjective "windig" is made from the noun "Wind". Give one more example. (2 marks)

51. Write these numbers in German: 3, 7, 11. (3 marks)

52. Give two reasons why imitating a teacher or a recording helps when learning German sounds. (2 marks)

53. Write the German words with der, die or das for: cocoa, party. (2 marks)

54. Write the German words with der, die or das for: lamp, tomato. (2 marks)

55. Write the German words with der, die or das for: face, father. (2 marks)

56. Give three tips for reading a tongue twister well. (3 marks)

57. Write the German words with der, die or das for: mother, rainbow, hair. (3 marks)

58. Write the German words with der, die or das for: room, sun. (2 marks)

59. Write a menu for one day in German with three meals. (3 marks)

60. Write the numbers 3, 9 and 12 in German. (3 marks)

61. Explain how to pronounce ß, sch and z, with one example each. (3 marks)

62. Write the German names of these months: October, November, December. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Vater
   Vater is a der word, so we say mein Vater.

2. B — Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer.
   Schlafzimmer is a das word, so we use im.

3. A — Mittwoch
   Mittwoch comes from the middle of the week.

4. C — Sonntag
   After Samstag comes Sonntag.

5. C — 5
   fünf is the number 5.

6. A — knee
   das Knie means knee.

7. B — thunderstorm
   das Gewitter means thunderstorm.

8. D — koo
   In German the letter Q is called koo.

9. B — like sh
   German sch sounds like the English sh.

10. A — kind
   nett means kind.

11. D — die
   It is die Tochter, so the little word is die.

12. B — bed
   das Bett means bed.

13. D — der
   It is der Kühlschrank, so the little word is der.

14. B — party
   die Party means party.

15. A — cake
   der Kuchen means cake.

16. D — cocoa
   der Kakao means cocoa.

17. B — das
   It is das Brot, so the little word is das.

18. B — das Gemüse
   der Kohl belongs to das Gemüse.

19. B — foot
   der Fuß means foot.

20. D — black hair
   schwarz = black, Haare = hair.

21. C — What do I see with?
   womit means with what.

22. A — to help
   helfen means to help.

23. B — liest
   lesen changes to liest for er.

24. B — die
   It is die Mutter, so the little word is die.

25. D — der
   It is der Tisch, so the little word is der.

26. B — die Lampe
   lamp in German is die Lampe.

27. B — Küche
   Küche has ü.

28. D — tanzen
   to dance in German is tanzen.

29. C — lesen
   to read in German is lesen.

30. A — November
   November in German is November.

31. C — September
   September in German is September.

32. C — first
   der erste means first.

33. B — der Saft
   juice in German is der Saft.

34. B — die
   It is die Banane, so the little word is die.

35. A — die Bohne
   bean in German is die Bohne.

36. C — der Mund
   mouth in German is der Mund.

37. C — Zahn
   Zahn has a silent h after the a.

38. C — hot
   heiß means hot.

39. D — cool
   kühl means cool.

40. B — der
   Wand is a die word, so an der Wand.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist an der Wand. Der Tisch ist neben dem Bett. Die Tasche ist unter dem Tisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen and Guten Abend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each greeting spelled correctly.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Write only to people you know; do not share private information; ask an adult first.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Healthy: Obst, Gemüse, Bohnen. Unhealthy: Süßigkeiten, Limonade.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for three healthy foods, 1 mark for two unhealthy foods, 1 mark for correct spelling.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr, die Wolke, der Kuchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

46. (4 marks)
   Answer: Guten Morgen! Wie geht's? Gut, danke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Guten Morgen, 1 mark for Wie geht's?, 1 mark for Gut, danke, 1 mark for capital letters and punctuation.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Messer, der Luftballon.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

48. (4 marks)
   Answer: die Küche, das Schlafzimmer, der Garten, das Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Some information is wrong; reliable sources have been checked.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each point.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: Add -ig to the noun: Wind + -ig = windig. Another example: Sonne + -ig = sonnig.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the rule, 1 mark for the example.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, sieben, elf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

52. (2 marks)
   Answer: We hear the right sounds and practise them again and again, so our mouth learns them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Kakao, die Party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

54. (2 marks)
   Answer: die Lampe, die Tomate.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Gesicht, der Vater.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read slowly at first; add a few words at a time; speed up only when it is clear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

57. (3 marks)
   Answer: die Mutter, der Regenbogen, das Haar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

58. (2 marks)
   Answer: das Zimmer, die Sonne.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (2 marks).

59. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Frühstück: Tee und Brot. Mittagessen: Reis und Bohnen. Abendessen: Ugali und Fisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meal correctly written.

60. (3 marks)
   Answer: drei, neun, zwölf.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

61. (3 marks)
   Answer: ß is a strong ss (Fuß). sch is sh (Schulter). z is ts (Zahn).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

62. (3 marks)
   Answer: Oktober, November, Dezember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.
